description: Stock quotidien dans les stockages de gaz (à partir de novembre 2010) is a dataset listed in Open Data Réseaux Énergies (ODRÉ), a shared open data portal of the French energy network operators, published or maintained by RTE, GRTgaz, Teréga, Enedis, GRDF and other French network operators (ODRÉ). Ce jeu de données présente le stock de gaz présent dans les stockages de gaz de Teréga et Storengy, par PITS et en fin de journée gazière depuis le 1 er novembre 2010 (GWh PCS 0°C). Coverage: France. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Stockage. The portal shows 2026-09-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odre-open-data-portal.
